description: This PHP source file defines the class `PopupMetaDataParser`, which extends `ListLayoutMetaDataParser`. It manages metadata parsing for popup views in the SuiteCRM module builder, including handling configuration for search and list views in popup interfaces, merging view definitions, and saving the updated metadata. The file incorporates methods for converting definitions, handling save operations, and managing view-specific properties.

classes.name: PopupMetaDataParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling popup view metadata, including search and list view configurations, merging definitions, and persisting changes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser with specific view, module, and package information, setting up columns and view definitions based on whether it's a search or list view.

methods.name: mergeFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Merges view definitions and field definitions, converting search definitions into list definitions for consistent processing.

methods.name: convertSearchToListDefs
methods.description: Converts search view definitions into list view definitions to unify the display structure.

methods.name: getOriginalViewDefs
methods.description: Returns the original view definitions after converting search definitions to list definitions.

methods.name: getSearchFields
methods.description: Extracts and returns the search fields from the view definitions, including labels.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the modified popup metadata to a PHP file, handling different environments and updating definitions based on view type (search or list).

methods.name: addNewSearchDef
methods.description: Adds new search definitions to the popup metadata, updating where clauses and search inputs.

methods.name: _diffAndUpdate
methods.description: Updates target definitions by comparing new definitions, removing or adding entries as needed for search conditions.

methods.name: _getTargetModuleName
methods.description: Determines the module name string based on the field definition, considering custom fields.
